# MealEvent

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened related to a Meal.

## Scope note

The occurrence of a Meal (a logged eating occasion), as distinct from the Meal/Recipe planning concepts themselves.

## Broader

- [DiabetesEvent](../DiabetesEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
